tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a file, view an image, or list a directory. Large text files are shown as bounded excerpts with their file size; use a line range to inspect a specific section. Directory listings are non-recursive and show up to 50 entries by default.

filePath.description: File or directory path on this Node. Relative paths use the session working directory supplied for this Node, or its agent directory if unset. Absolute paths and ~/ paths are accepted subject to permissions. On Main and CLI Nodes, a leading $fw_agentdir or $fw_tmp expands to this Agent's directory or its tmp directory. Other leading $ names are rejected.

startLine.description: First line to read, counting from 1. For directories, the first entry to list. Omit or use 0 to start at the beginning.

endLine.description: Last line or directory entry to include, counting from 1. Omit or use 0 for the default range.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write text to a file on this Node. Existing files are protected unless overwrite is true; missing parent directories are created only when createDirs is true.

filePath.description: Destination path on this Node. Relative paths use the session working directory supplied for this Node, or its agent directory if unset. Absolute paths and ~/ paths are accepted subject to permissions. On Main and CLI Nodes, a leading $fw_agentdir or $fw_tmp expands to this Agent's directory or its tmp directory. Other leading $ names are rejected.

overwrite.description: Allow replacement of an existing file. Defaults to false.

createDirs.description: Create missing parent directories. Defaults to false.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Replace one exact occurrence of text in a file. Use apply_patch when a line-based patch is more suitable.

filePath.description: File to edit on this Node. Relative paths use the session working directory supplied for this Node, or its agent directory if unset. Absolute paths and ~/ paths are accepted subject to permissions. On Main and CLI Nodes, a leading $fw_agentdir or $fw_tmp expands to this Agent's directory or its tmp directory. Other leading $ names are rejected.

oldText.description: Exact text to replace; it must identify a single occurrence.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.description: Add, modify, or delete files on this Node using the apply_patch format with *** Begin Patch and *** End Patch. Relative paths in patch headers use the session working directory supplied for this Node, or its agent directory if unset. On Main and CLI Nodes, a leading $fw_agentdir or $fw_tmp expands to this Agent's directory or its tmp directory. Other leading $ names are rejected.

input.description: Complete patch text with Add File, Update File, or Delete File operations.

tools.name: get_default_cwd
tools.description: Get this Node's process working directory, used by exec when neither a command nor the session specifies one.
